scope: Current local suite state after removing the 3x integration duplication and moving integration fixtures onto the shared tenant seeder (__tests__/helpers/tenant-seed.ts).

layers.unit: __tests__/unit — in-process; Supabase client is mocked. No app server, no database.
layers.integration: __tests__/integration — in-process; imports route handlers (36 files) or services/RPCs directly (17 files). No app HTTP server. Requires only Supabase: API :54321 (PostgREST, GoTrue, Storage) and Postgres :54322.
layers.e2e: __tests__/e2e — the only layer that needs the app. Playwright's webServer boots :3000; the admin-api project also boots :4000. Not run for this report.

failures.cause: The test calls `logoutPost()` with no argument. The logout route is wrapped in `withPublicTracing` -> `withRequestInstrumentation`, which reads `req.method`; `req` is undefined.
failures.expectedBehaviour: Logout responds 200 and clears the active_org_id cookie (empty value, Expires 1970, no Max-Age).
failures.suggestedFix: Pass a request, matching the other auth tests: `logoutPost(createNextRequest('http://localhost/api/v1/auth/logout', { method: 'POST' }))`. No production-code change is needed.
failures.ownershipNote: Untouched by the 3x removal and by the tenant-seeder migration; the test file has no forEachCopy usage and did not change.

failures.test: returns 404 for a manager of another org and keeps the membership (#189)
failures.cause: Only reproduces when the integration files run in parallel (`fileParallelism: true`). The test deletes a membership through the route and then reads `org_members` back: under load the row is already gone, so the 'membership must be untouched' assertion sees []. Passes in isolation and in the serial run.
failures.expectedBehaviour: A manager of another org gets 404 and the target's membership stays in place.
failures.suggestedFix: Run the suite with `--no-file-parallelism` (524/525, only the documented logout failure) until the cross-file interference is isolated; do not weaken the assertion.
failures.ownershipNote: File was touched by the tenant-seeder commit (seedOrgMembership/createTestUser call sites), but this failure does not reproduce at any commit in isolation or serially.

failures.test: returns 404 when the target is not a member of the active org (#189)
failures.cause: Parallel-only. The request is rejected as FORBIDDEN (403) instead of NOT_FOUND (404), i.e. the caller is resolved as a non-manager at the moment the route runs — the same cross-file interference that hits the neighbouring case. Passes in isolation and serially.
failures.expectedBehaviour: Deleting a non-member as an org manager answers 404 NOT_FOUND.
failures.suggestedFix: Same as the previous entry: run serially (`--no-file-parallelism`) until the shared-state race is isolated.
failures.ownershipNote: Same file and commit as the entry above.

environmentNotes: No test under __tests__/integration needs the web app on :3000 or the admin app on :4000. The `http://localhost` URLs in those tests are only parsed by createNextRequest (__tests__/integration/test-utils.ts); no request is sent to them. The only real HTTP calls go to Supabase REST/Storage on :54321.

If Supabase local is not running, integration suites fail during setup with `seed <email>: fetch failed` from __tests__/helpers/tenant-seed.ts (ensureAccount). That is an environment failure, not a test failure; start Supabase and re-run.
Playwright e2e was not run. It is the only layer that needs the app: Playwright boots :3000 itself via `webServer`, and the admin-api project also boots :4000 (skip locally with E2E_SKIP_ADMIN_WS=1).

Integration under `--file-parallelism` (the vitest default) can flake on __tests__/integration/members.test.ts: two DELETE-member cases fail only when other files run concurrently (documented above with `onlyWithFileParallelism: true`). The serial run is the baseline: 524/525 with the single pre-existing logout failure.
